PEC.name: predicted concentration
PEC.definition: Model estimate of drug concentration at a site, in ng/L.

PNEC.name: no-effect threshold
PNEC.definition: Concentration below which no ecotoxicological effect is expected, in ng/L.

RQ.name: risk ratio
RQ.definition: PEC ÷ PNEC; values > 1 indicate potential concern.

LOD.name: detection limit
LOD.definition: Analytical limit of detection for a drug, in ng/L.

\u03bb.name: leakage
\u03bb.definition: Fraction of wastewater entering the stream untreated (sewer leakage, misconnections).

Q.name: stream flow
Q.definition: Stream discharge in m³/s; higher flow dilutes concentrations.

\u03c4.name: travel time
\u03c4.definition: Time for water to travel from entry point to monitoring site, in hours.

k.name: in-stream loss rate
k.definition: First-order decay rate constant in 1/h (biodegradation, sorption, photolysis).

fe.name: excretion fraction
fe.definition: Fraction of a dose excreted as unchanged parent compound.

DDD.name: daily dose
DDD.definition: WHO defined daily dose in grams; used to convert consumption statistics to mass.

score.name: sampling priority score
score.definition: Fraction of simulation draws with RQ > 1. Guides where to sample first. Not a probability of exceedance.
